decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed erection of a side extension, to the existing  dwellinghouse   
would, by reason of its size, position and appearance  in relation to  neighbouring residential properties, be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the amenities of adjoining occupiers and involve the loss of a yew tree and is contrary to the Policies ENV 1.1 (All New Development),  ENV 1.9 (Trees and Community Woodlands)
 and H3.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB 1.1 (New Development),  ENVN 2.7 (Trees and Community Woodlands) and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines.     


2/ The proposed erection of a side extension, to the existing  dwellinghouse   
would, by reason of its size, position and appearance,  not preserve or enhance the character of the Osterley Park Conservation Area and is contrary to the Policy ENV 1.2 (Conservation Areas)  of the Unitary Development Plan and  ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to dwellinghouse.
